pageBand.title: Our work
pageBand.standfirst: Current work, and examples of what we have each led over the last two decades.

intro.heading: A track record built over two decades
intro.paragraph: From national programme design and RCT-backed evaluation to regional leadership on Best Start in Life, our work spans the full width of the early years system.

items: National Centre for Family Hubs regional leadership and contribution to national support on Best Start in Life and Inclusion Toolkit (Local Government Association)

Finalist for a Health Services Journal Award (Reducing Inequalities and Improving Outcomes for Children and Young People) and winner of the 2025 Excellence in Health Creation Award for Best Health-Creating Grassroots Approach to Reducing the Impact of Long-Term Conditions

Strategic programme development to address health inequalities for babies, children and young people within a London borough, recognised as good practice across North-West London (NWL) in asthma prevention and care through the Getting It Right First Time (GIRFT) assessment
Leadership of the redevelopment, evaluation and scaling of NSPCC's Pregnancy in Mind (PiM) programme

Programme development leadership for the translation and implementation of an innovative U.S. evidence-based parent infant relationship approach adopted by the NSPCC to improve permanency decisions and the mental health of children under 5 in care proceedings due to maltreatment, supported by an NIHR-funded RCT

Development, training and national rollout of recognised evidence-informed Home Learning Environment programmes, including NCB's Making it REAL (Raising Early Achievement in Literacy) and Save the Children UK's Families Connect, supported by RCT evidence of impact on children's social and emotional development and parental self-efficacy
Programme and project management of C4EO (Centre for Excellence and Outcomes in Children and Young People's Services)
Senior involvement in the National Evaluation of Sure Start (NESS) and over eight years of subsequent consultancy support to Sure Start Children's Centres, NHS and local authorities
